notes: No timing samples. Every successful/error prefix, metadata field, exact cost and lifetime-cost delta is compared with physical join-plan reuse disabled.

Both sides retain ordinary resolved-root reuse. Physical cache observations are separate; the NULL binding and following non-NULL binding retain their own planner call counts and entry-identity observations.

The five named physical targets must retain a plan and avoid the original planner on every warmed non-NULL binding in every API/storage mode; the disabled control must still enter it. NULL preserves the plan identity and matches the disabled control, including upstream pruning. Range and fenced cases remain explicit fallbacks.

Workloads and budget semantic digests are separate from analyzed-skew observations: the archived source predates the statistics-context correction. Each source must independently match its physical-disabled control; any cross-source skew change requires explicit correctness evidence and is not a performance comparison.

Physical snapshot freeze checks traverse owned containers, while explicitly excluding borrowed table descriptors and existing Expression objects. They do not claim that all reachable metadata is immutable.

Physical winners are observed at the PreparedJoins planner wrapper return, including cache hits. The archived source has no multiway wrapper, so its NWayJoins return is observed instead. Base planner calls are counted separately; duplicate identical per-invocation plans are collapsed. EXPLAIN remains on its ordinary path.
All budget prefixes are checked for queries costing at most64; larger cases use the explicitly recorded representative ceilings.
Cache retention is observed only after its owning thread and database have completed; remaining weak references are reported without hiding VM roots.
